text.en: This Order may be cited as the Insurance !Amendment) Order, 2007. of section 33 of S 48/06.
Section 33 of the Insurance Order, 2006, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended in subsection {2), by deleting "31" from the second by substituting "32" therefor. of section 72.
Section 72 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection l1)(c}, by deleting "63" from the last line and by substituting "71" therefor. of new section 77 A.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 77 - of officers. 77 A. ( 1) Any person exercising any functions under this Order shall carry an authority card in a form approved by the Authority which card shall identify the holder and his office and which shall be produced by the holder on demand to any person having reasonable grounds to make that demand. {2) Where any person exercising any functions under this Order an authority card in a form approved under subsection {1) or any other written identification or authority, then, until the contrary is proved, that authority card or other written identification or authority shall be presumed to be genuine and he shall be presumed to be person referred to therein. 13) It shall not be an offence for any person to refuse to comply with any demand or order made by any person exercising any functions under this Order, if such latter person refuses on demand being made by such firstmentioned person to declare his office and to produce his authority card or other written identification or authority.". of Fourth Schedule.

The Fourth Schedule to the principal Order is amended, in paragraph 513) by deleting "8111 from the penultimate line and by substituting "85" therefor. Made this 26th. day of Syawal, 1428 Hijriah corresponding to the 7th. day of Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN DARUSSALAM.
